scope: Initial bounded literature sprint for the phase after scoped learning

sources.title: MemGPT
sources.mechanism: Managed context tiers and explicit movement between them
sources.relevance: Context management; distinct from validating learned lessons

sources.title: A-MEM
sources.mechanism: Linked atomic notes and evolving connections
sources.relevance: Evidence navigation and relevant retrieval; model-generated links need checking

sources.title: Mem0
sources.mechanism: Extracted fact memory, update decisions, optional graph memory
sources.relevance: Useful efficiency baseline; paper, OSS, and hosted product differ

sources.title: Zep
sources.mechanism: Temporal knowledge graphs
sources.relevance: Time-aware facts and provenance; greater infrastructure burden

sources.title: Reflexion
sources.mechanism: Verbal feedback for another attempt
sources.relevance: Later same-task correction option, currently deferred

sources.title: ExpeL
sources.mechanism: Insights from success/failure contrast plus retrieved episodes
sources.relevance: Conditions supporting a lesson and transfer to unseen tasks

sources.title: Voyager
sources.mechanism: Executable skill library with environmental feedback
sources.relevance: Future verified procedures; substantial additional scope

sources.title: Generative Agents
sources.mechanism: Evidence-linked reflection and selective retrieval
sources.relevance: Source-event pointers; its measured objective is believability

sources.title: MemoryBank
sources.mechanism: Conversation profiles and heuristic forgetting
sources.relevance: User-specific memory; recency is not proof of correctness

sources.title: ACE
sources.mechanism: Stable playbook IDs, counters, and localized deltas
sources.relevance: Auditable rule changes without rewriting the entire store

sources.title: MemRL
sources.mechanism: Relevance filtering followed by reward-based utility ranking
sources.relevance: Retrieve advice by observed usefulness as well as similarity

sources.title: Live-Evo
sources.mechanism: Memory-on/off outcome contrast before write-back
sources.relevance: Candidate-promotion experiment in replayable tasks

sources.title: Useful Memories Become Faulty When Continuously Updated by LLMs
sources.mechanism: Negative evidence on repeated consolidation
sources.relevance: Preserve episodes and test consolidation rather than assuming benefit

sources.title: TARL
sources.mechanism: Executable add/revise/no-op/reject/defer transactions
sources.relevance: Precise memory-update semantics and state-transition tests

sources.title: Dependency-Guided Rollback Repair
sources.mechanism: Trace dependencies and selective repair after diagnosed faults
sources.relevance: Retire contaminated derived memories while preserving unrelated ones

sources.title: MemoryLACE
sources.mechanism: Local merge, supersession, contradiction, and temporal links
sources.relevance: Lightweight lifecycle model instead of a comprehensive graph

sources.title: LoCoMo
sources.mechanism: Long conversation recall
sources.relevance: Fact-recall diagnostic; dataset/version differences matter

sources.title: LongMemEval
sources.mechanism: Extraction, temporal reasoning, updates, and abstention
sources.relevance: Useful QA suite; does not establish obsolete-memory removal

sources.title: MemoryArena
sources.mechanism: Interdependent shopping, travel, search, and reasoning tasks
sources.relevance: Closer to everyday assistant reliability

sources.title: STALE
sources.mechanism: Implicit state changes and resistance to stale premises
sources.relevance: Changed circumstances must change later recommendations

sources.title: MINJA
sources.mechanism: Query-induced poisoning of persistent agent memory
sources.relevance: Test whether untrusted interaction becomes durable guidance

sources.title: MemoryGraft
sources.mechanism: Procedural poisoning through ingested artifacts
sources.relevance: Distinguish poison admission, retrieval, and executed behavior
